day_shape: 78 items: CENTCOM confirms fresh US strikes on Iranian targets and a naval blockade with 9 vessels redirected, IRGC claims drone attacks on US bases in Kuwait and missiles toward Jordan, FCDO withdraws Iran embassy staff, Trump threatens Iranian bridges/power plants over Hormuz attacks.

threads.label: US strikes and naval blockade on Iran
threads.summary: CENTCOM announced fresh strikes on Iranian military targets from 5:30pm ET and said it has redirected 9 commercial vessels and disabled 1 to enforce a naval blockade, with reports of a B-1 bomber deployed. Jerusalem Post reported the US is increasing forces in the region and Rubio said Washington remains open to diplomacy while targeting Iran's shipping-attack capability.

threads.label: IRGC claims strikes on Kuwait, Jordan bases
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried IRGC and army statements claiming 'Phase 23 of Operation Thunderbolt' drone strikes on three US bases in Kuwait and messaging directed at the peoples of Kuwait and Jordan, with Jerusalem Post citing IRGC claims of damaging a Patriot system. Kuwait said its air defences were intercepting 'hostile Iranian drone threats' and smoke was reported over Aqaba after US interceptions.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea shipping
threads.summary: CENTCOM publicly rejected as false an IRGC Navy claim to control Strait of Hormuz transit, while Trump threatened to strike an Iranian bridge or power plant for each ship attacked; Khamenei's office posted messages framing Hormuz management as Iran's role. Reuters reported five tankers changed course in the Red Sea after Houthi warnings, Saudi Arabia confirmed a vessel was hit, and Defa Press claimed a vessel caught fire near Hormuz.

threads.label: UK and European diplomatic posture
threads.summary: The FCDO updated Iran and Yemen travel advice and withdrew embassy staff from Tehran, per Jerusalem Post. Bulgaria dismissed Iran's warning that hosting US tanker aircraft would amount to complicity in 'aggression and war crimes', and Iran denied mistreating two French diplomats detained in Tehran.

threads.label: Iranian leadership messaging and diplomacy
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released statements on 'vengeance', denouncing America as 'the great devil' and thanking the Iraqi nation, while FM Araghchi warned any US strike on Iranian infrastructure would draw responses against any country that aided it. Iraqi PM al-Sudani travelled to Tehran, with Defa Press saying his agenda included bridging Iran-US positions to end the war.

threads.label: Intelligence, nuclear and Saudi track
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Mossad chief Roman Gofman met CIA Director Ratcliffe in Washington on the Iran war, and that US analysts are examining possible Russian assistance to Iranian drone attacks on CIA facilities in the Gulf. Separate reports flagged critics' concerns about a US-Saudi civilian nuclear deal and a former Israeli navy commander warning Iran's nuclear resolve has increased since the war.

threads.label: Gaza, Hamas and Lebanon track
threads.summary: The IDF released details identifying 12 Gaza operatives previously described as soccer players as Hamas and PIJ members, and Israel is seeking to revoke the citizenship of two men convicted of wartime conspiracy with Hamas. Lebanon and Israel are scheduled to hold US-brokered talks in Italy on 4 August, and Hamas is reported to be tightening ties with Gaza clans.
